$comment: The text of each adaptation in configuration/adaptive-messages.json, by message key and adaptation key. Each field fills one of Rock's own adaptation attributes: callToAction is Call To Action Text, link is Call To Action Link, summary is Summary, details is Details (one paragraph each), and image is Summary Image, an approved event image from photos/events/manifest.json by event key. An adaptation with no image here gets its own image from photos/messages/manifest.json once the message image brief (photos/message-brief.md) delivers it, and leaves Summary Image empty until then. A link is one of the External Website's routes, or page:<key> for a page in the configuration's 'pages'. README.md has the rules, and check-messages.js checks them.

invite-a-friend.summary: You already help people grow. This month, invite one friend to church, and save them a seat beside you on Sunday.
details: Most people first come to church because a friend asked them. Think of one person who would enjoy a Sunday with you.
Send them the New Here page for service times and what to expect, then meet them at the welcome tent.

lead.summary: You're growing, you serve on a team, and you're in a group. Would you lead one? Group Leader Training gets you ready.
details: Leading a group starts with people you already know. Invite a few friends, pick a study, and open your home or a table at a coffee shop.
Group Leader Training covers the basics in one evening, and a coach checks in with you all season.

serve.summary: You've taken a step to grow. Now find a team where your gifts make a difference on Sunday mornings.
details: Greeters, kids, students, worship, production, and more. Most teams serve once or twice a month.
Pick a team that sounds fun, and a team leader will reach out to set up your first Sunday.

grow.summary: You've found your people. Foundations is the next step: six weeks on what we believe and why it matters.
details: Foundations covers what Christians believe, how to read the Bible, and how to pray. Bring your questions.
You will leave with a clear picture of the faith, and friends who are growing right beside you.

belong.summary: Sundays are better with friends. Join a small group near you and get to know a few people well.
details: Groups meet in homes all over the Valley, most of them once a week. Many offer child care.
Not sure where to start? Small Group Connect introduces you to several leaders in one night.

starting-point.summary: We're glad you keep coming back. Starting Point is a four-week class on who we are and how to get connected.
details: Starting Point meets on Wednesday nights, and dinner is on us.
You will hear our story, meet a few staff, and find the next step that fits you.

find-your-next-step.summary: You're part of Sundays here. Tell us what interests you, and we'll help you find the next step that fits.
details: Groups, classes, and serving teams all start with a short conversation. Fill out the form, and someone from your campus will reach out this week.
Not sure what fits? That is what the conversation is for.

we-miss-you.summary: We've missed you on Sundays. Life gets full, and that's okay. Your seat is still here whenever you're ready.
details: Services last about an hour, and you can always catch a recent message online first.
If something hard is going on, a pastor would be glad to talk or pray with you.

plan-a-visit.summary: We'd love to meet you. Find a service time, what to expect, and where to park.
details: Come as you are. Services last about an hour, and kids have their own rooms with safe check-in.
Look for the welcome tent when you arrive, and we will walk you in.

thank-you.summary: Thank you for your Built on the Rock commitment. Together we are building a Student Center and new kids rooms.
details: Your gifts are already at work. Plans for the Student Center are drawn, and the first kids rooms come next.
You can see your gifts toward your commitment any time on your giving page.

commit.summary: Built on the Rock is our two-year campaign for a Student Center and new kids rooms. Pray about what you can give.
details: Like the wise builder in Matthew 7, we want to build on a foundation that lasts for the next generation.
Every commitment counts, whatever its size. Make yours online in a minute.

see-what-were-building.summary: Through Built on the Rock, we are building a Student Center and new kids rooms, so the next generation has room to grow.
details: Plans for the Student Center are drawn, and the first kids rooms come next.
Pray with us for the students and kids who will meet Jesus in these rooms.

invitation.summary: Baptism Sunday is coming. If you have decided to follow Jesus, take the next step with your church family.
details: Baptism is a public way to say that Jesus changed your life. Your friends and family can cheer you on.
Sign up, and a pastor will call to talk it through and answer your questions.

whos-your-one.summary: Baptism Sunday is coming. Who's your one? Pray for one friend by name, and invite them to come celebrate with you.
details: Every baptism is a story of someone who invited, prayed, and stayed close. Think of one friend who is far from God, and pray for them every day this month.
Then invite them to Baptism Sunday. Sit together, and cheer for every story.

come-celebrate.summary: Baptism Sunday is coming. Join us as friends and neighbors share how Jesus changed their lives.
details: Baptisms happen in every service that day. Bring your family and cheer them on.
Thinking about being baptized yourself? Talk with a pastor after any service.

register.summary: A week in the pines with your friends, great teaching, and plenty of fun. Camp spots fill fast, so sign up early.
details: Camp is for students in grades 7 to 12. Your leaders come too, and you ride the buses together.
Payment plans and scholarships are open to anyone who asks.

get-your-student-to-camp.summary: Student Camp is a week your student will talk about for years. Spots fill fast, so register early.
details: Camp is for students in grades 7 to 12. Leaders ride the buses with them, and every cabin has a trained adult.
Payment plans and scholarships are open to any family who asks.

know-a-student.summary: Know a student in grades 7 to 12? Student Camp is a great first step into our student ministry. Invite them along.
details: Camp is a week in the pines with great teaching, small groups, and plenty of fun.
Scholarships are open to anyone who asks, so cost never keeps a student home.

scheduled.summary: Thank you for giving faithfully. This year your gifts sent students to camp and filled food boxes for neighbors.
details: Your scheduled gift helps us plan with confidence, week after week.
You can change the amount, the date, or your card at any time.

first-gift.summary: Thank you for your first gift! Here is what happens next: a thank you note, and a giving statement each January.
details: Every gift is counted with care by our finance team, and it goes to the ministry you chose.
Your giving page shows every gift, so you never have to keep track yourself.

make-it-automatic.summary: You give faithfully. A recurring gift makes it automatic, so it happens even on the weeks you are away.
details: Pick an amount and a day, and use a card or a bank account. You can change it any time.
Many people find that giving first, instead of last, makes it easier to plan the month.

give-online.summary: Give online any time, from any phone or computer. Or set up a recurring gift that fits your own rhythm.
details: Online gifts take a minute, and they count toward your giving statement each January.
A recurring gift can be monthly, quarterly, or on the Sunday after each payday.

this-year.summary: We're glad you're part of this church. This year we baptized new believers, sent students to camp, and served our city.
details: None of it happens alone. Thank you for every way you have been part of it.
Catch up on a recent message any time, and come back on Sunday. We saved you a seat.

generosity.summary: Generosity starts with a plan. Money Matters is a class on budgeting, getting out of debt, and giving with joy.
details: Money Matters meets for five Monday nights, with a coach at every table. Couples and singles are both welcome.
You will build a simple budget and leave with a plan for what comes next.

ways-to-give.summary: Give online, set up a recurring gift, or drop a check in the offering. Every gift helps our church serve the Valley.
details: Online giving is safe and takes a minute. You can give to the General Fund, Missions, or Built on the Rock.
Every gift gets a giving statement each January.
